children: Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) (“Rogers”) today announced that it will host an Investor Day on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, in New York City. Rogers’ President and CEO Ali El-Haj and other members of the senior leadership team will provide details on Rogers’ strategy, key growth opportunities, capital allocation priorities and multi-year financial objectives. The event will include formal presentations from Rogers’ management team, followed by a question-and-answer session.

The event will begin at 9:00 a.m. ET and is expected to conclude by approximately 11:30 a.m. ET. Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only. A live webcast of the event, presentation materials and an on-demand replay will be available through the Investor Relations section of Rogers’ website at

Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) is a global leader in engineered materials to power, protect and connect our world. Rogers delivers innovative solutions to help our customers solve their toughest material challenges. Rogers’ advanced electronic and elastomeric materials are used in applications for EV/HEV, automotive safety and radar systems, mobile devices, renewable energy, wireless infrastructure, energy-efficient motor drives, industrial equipment and more.
